edges.review_reason: Theorem 1.1 (PDF pp.30–32) concerns a Ky Fan k-norm tail bound for polynomial functions of dependent random T-product tensors along a stationary walk on a regular expander, with tensor positivity/order and graph-walk hypotheses. Its assumption 4 requires finite C,sigma>0 with beta_0(t) <= C/(sigma*sqrt(2*pi))*exp(-t^2/(2*sigma^2)) for all real t, while Theorem 8 (PDF p.22, formula (122)) fixes beta_0(t)=pi/[2(cosh(pi*t)+1)]. For t>=0, beta_0(t)>=(pi/4)exp(-pi*t), so the ratio to any such Gaussian majorant is at least [pi*sigma*sqrt(2*pi)/(4*C)]*exp(t^2/(2*sigma^2)-pi*t), which tends to infinity. The assumption class is therefore empty for the paper's beta_0. This establishes vacuity/unusability as printed, not falsity of a valid probability inequality under a corrected or restricted hypothesis.
